_comment: Copy to site.json and fill in your own SAP systems. site.json is git-ignored. base_url = the Gateway / ICM HTTPS endpoint (https://<host>:443<instance number>); client = the client (mandt) your users log into. Set verify_tls to false only for internal hosts with self-signed certificates.
